name: Land Cruiser FJ55
body_style: 4-door station wagon, 2,700mm wheelbase - Toyota's first dedicated SUV-style wagon body
notes: Originally shipped with the F engine before switching to 2F in 1975 (2F used here as representative). Diff ratio changed to 3.70 late in the run (1978-80) per some sources - 4.11 used here as the longer-lived figure. Unique among FJ wagons for a tailgate-only rear (electric window, no separate hatch).
